verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official, self-hostable MCP server built on its open plugin API for 'multi-directional' AI workflows. Its docs describe agents generating editable design structures, creating high-fidelity artifacts, and migrating Figma designs into Penpot, which are all write operations. A plugin system and token-authenticated API add further programmatic surfaces. The evidence is marketing-level: it never enumerates specific write operations or MCP tools, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. missing for 10: detailed documentation of write-capable MCP tools or API endpoints (create/modify shapes, components, tokens), independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can actually edit designs.
